title: Every Reason These Predators Are Scarier Than Their Reputation (Marathon)
intro: Doug thinks he knows what a dangerous animal looks like. The mamba, the anaconda, the grizzly and the shoebill disagree. Four predators, four very different ways to end him, back to back.
description: Four full episodes, back to back: the black mamba, the anaconda, the grizzly bear and the shoebill, each with a deadly trick nobody warned Doug about. Real science, cartoon deaths.
